data.name: Fmt_MonthYear
data.comment: .NET date pattern. Example result: October 2026.

data.comment: .NET date pattern. Example result: Oct 24.

data.name: Fmt_MonthDayYear
data.comment: .NET date pattern. Example result: Oct 24, 2026.

data.name: Fmt_WeekRangeSameMonthStart
data.comment: .NET date pattern for the first day of a week title inside one month. Each language orders and decorates the year, month and day its own way. Example: Oct 19 (in Oct 19 – 25, 2026). A lone d must be written %d.

data.name: Fmt_WeekRangeSameMonthEnd
data.comment: .NET date pattern for the last day of a week title inside one month. Example: 25, 2026 (in Oct 19 – 25, 2026).

data.name: Fmt_WeekRangeCrossMonthStart
data.comment: .NET date pattern for the first day of a week title across two months of one year. Example: Oct 26 (in Oct 26 – Nov 1, 2026).

data.name: Fmt_WeekRangeCrossMonthEnd
data.comment: .NET date pattern for the last day of a week title across two months of one year. Example: Nov 1, 2026 (in Oct 26 – Nov 1, 2026).

data.comment: .NET date pattern. Example result: Saturday, Oct 24.

data.name: Fmt_WeekdayMonthDayYear
data.comment: .NET date pattern. Example result: Saturday, Oct 24, 2026.

data.name: Fmt_ShortWeekdayMonthDay
data.comment: .NET date pattern. Example result: Sat, Oct 24.

data.name: Fmt_ShortWeekdayMonthDayYear
data.comment: .NET date pattern. Example result: Sat, Oct 24, 2026.

data.name: Fmt_FullDate
data.comment: .NET date pattern with the full month name. Example result: Saturday, October 24.

data.name: Fmt_FullDateYear
data.comment: .NET date pattern with the full month name. Example result: Saturday, October 24, 2026.
